newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends strongly higher on weather concern.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends strongly higher on weather concern.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter futures closed strongly higher on concerns about forecasts for cold weather this weekend in the U.S. Great Plains hard red winter wheat growing region, traders said.
"You draw a line from Amarillo, Texas to Enid, Oklahoma and you've got big problems. That is the 18 degree (Fahrenheit) line with no snow cover," the trader added.
Volume was estimated at 79.170 million bushels, above the 37.470 million traded Thursday.
KCBT hard red winter wheat closed seven to 19-1/2 cents higher, with May up 16 at $4.51-1/2.
